scope: Read-only review of rational inversion and regularized endpoint/MZV algebra through weight six. No producer was edited.

mathematical_review.mobius_substitution: z=u/(1-u); dz/z=du/u-du/(u-1); dz/(z+1)=-du/(u-1). Signs agree with reginf_word.
mathematical_review.inversion_differential: G(0,v;1/z) derivative is -G(v;1/z)/z; G(-1,v;1/z) derivative is (-1/z+1/(1+z))*G(v;1/z).
mathematical_review.endpoint_regularization: At u=1 use shuffle-regularized G(0;1)=Reg G(1;1)=0, remove trailing zero and leading one, and translate convergent words to (-1)^depth*MZV.
mathematical_review.mzv_reduction: Depth-one periods, duality, convergent shuffle/stuffle products, and single-zeta(1) regularization give exact unique reductions through weight six. The zeta(1)^2 case is excluded, avoiding its shuffle/stuffle regularization correction.
mathematical_review.finding: No issue found in the reviewed scope.

controls_scope: Expected MZV and RegInf identities are specified separately from the implementation; involution executes the implementation under review on every word. This is not a second original-integral evaluation or a separate CAS integration.
limits: Exact computational algebra, not a formal proof.
No new proof of original ordered-domain integrations, complex z or i0 continuation.
Reference dictionary reuse and coefficient comparisons are documented separately.
